scientific_integrity: Analytic proof is supplied with a separately implemented generator-based numerical check. General linear-filter and Markov-correlation identities are acknowledged as known.
scientific_limitations: Four-state directed cycle with equal exponential rates; stationary overdamped harmonic confinement without translational thermal diffusion; no unequal-rate or generalized-orientation claim. Numerical thresholds are approximations; publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Exact negative-memory bands in a cyclic run–rest particle under harmonic confinement
